NvidiaDriver.Description: Proprietary driver for the RTX 3050 Ti Mobile (GA107). Skip if you're on a Nobara -NV image, it's already there. Needs a reboot after first install for the akmod to build.
NvidiaDriver.check: rpm -q akmod-nvidia nvidia-driver xorg-x11-drv-nvidia 2>/dev/null | grep -qv 'is not installed' || lsmod | grep -q '^nvidia '

EnvyControl.Description: Switches between integrated/nvidia/hybrid GPU modes. Used instead of prime-select since this is AMD iGPU + NVIDIA dGPU, which prime-select's on-demand mode doesn't handle. Use: sudo envycontrol -s hybrid

CoreCtrl.Description: GUI for AMD iGPU power profiles / fan curves.

I8kutils.Description: DAMX's fan-control-tab equivalent - Dell's dell-smm-hwmon kernel driver plus i8kutils/i8kmon for manual or auto fan speed. Not confirmed supported on the G15 5515 specifically (dell-smm-hwmon uses a per-model whitelist, may need the 'force=1' module option) - best-effort like the RGB item.

AutoCpufreq.Description: Dynamic CPU governor switching for the 5800H. Pick this OR the TLP tweak, not both - they fight over the governor.

RyzenAdj.Description: CPU undervolt tool for the 5800H - worth trying against the freeze issue as an alternative to the C-state fix. Needs manual per-boot tuning afterward; start conservative.
install: dnf install -y cmake pciutils-devel git gcc-c++ make
cd /tmp/ryzenadj && mkdir -p build && cd build && cmake .. && make -j$(nproc) && make install

Steam.Description: Valve's PC game store and launcher.
Steam.note: Native RPM (RPM Fusion) - the SteamOS-style approach: Steam itself then manages Proton and the Steam Linux Runtime containers. A Flatpak Steam is deliberately NOT treated as satisfying this; its sandbox complicates controller access, external game drives, mods and LD_PRELOAD layers (MangoHud / gamescope / vkBasalt).

GameModeMangoHud.Description: Per-game CPU/GPU perf profile + FPS/frametime overlay. Launch with: gamemoderun mangohud %command%

Gamescope.Description: Valve's micro-compositor - resolution scaling / HDR / borderless-fullscreen fixes.

OpenRGB.Description: Vendor-agnostic RGB control. Best-effort for the AW-ELC per-key keyboard controller - not guaranteed to work on this model.

Nvtop.Description: Terminal GPU monitor (works for both the NVIDIA dGPU and AMD iGPU).

LmSensors.Description: Fan/thermal sensor readout, needed by btop/GOverlay for real data.

Fastfetch.Description: Quick system/hardware summary on terminal open.

Sunshine.Description: Self-hosted game-streaming host, pairs with Moonlight on a Steam Deck/tablet/other PC.

Moonlight.Description: Game-streaming client - stream FROM another PC/host TO this laptop.

Protontricks.Description: winetricks for Steam/Proton prefixes - install DLLs/fonts (vcrun2019, d3dcompiler_47, corefonts…) into a specific game's Proton prefix. Needed for the Rockstar launcher / Social Club under Proton.

Bottles.Description: Isolated Wine-prefix manager with bundled Wine-GE/Soda runners and a dependency installer - the non-Steam path for the Rockstar Games Launcher + GTA V. See the README's 'GTA V Online' section.

ProtonBattlEyeRuntime.Description: GTA Online uses BattlEye anti-cheat; Proton needs this runtime tool (Steam app 1161040) for it to load. Triggers a Steam install of it - Steam must be installed and will open. If it doesn't take, install 'Proton BattlEye Runtime' from your Steam library's Tools section manually.

ProtonEacRuntime.Description: Some Rockstar/other titles use EasyAntiCheat; this is the Proton runtime tool for it (Steam app 1826330). Same behaviour as the BattlEye runtime entry - opens Steam to install it.

VkBasalt.Description: Vulkan post-processing layer (CAS sharpening, FXAA, SMAA) - cheap image-quality boost for games, toggle in-game with a hotkey.

PrismLauncher.Description: Open-source Minecraft launcher - manage multiple instances, mod loaders (Fabric/Forge/Quilt/NeoForge) and modpacks side by side. The recommended MC launcher.

ModrinthApp.Description: Modrinth's own Minecraft launcher - one-click modpack install and mod management from the Modrinth catalogue.

ATLauncher.Description: Minecraft launcher with a big built-in modpack browser (FTB, Technic-style packs).

ItchIo.Description: The itch.io desktop app - install, update and launch indie games and jam builds.

Minigalaxy.Description: Lightweight GOG client - download and install your DRM-free GOG library without the Heroic/Lutris overhead.

Cartridges.Description: Unified game library - auto-imports Steam, Heroic, Lutris, Bottles, itch and Flatpak games into one launcher grid.

SteamRomManager.Description: Bulk-add non-Steam games and emulator ROMs to Steam with artwork from SteamGridDB - great for Big Picture / controller use.

Ludusavi.Description: Game save-file backup/restore, with cloud sync via rclone. Knows save locations for thousands of titles.

NtfsSupport.Description: Windows/dual-boot drives: the in-kernel ntfs3 driver (read/write) plus ntfs-3g (FUSE fallback) and ntfsprogs (mkfs.ntfs / ntfsfix). Nobara normally ships all of this already - this entry just confirms it and reinstalls if something's missing.
NtfsSupport.check: rpm -q ntfs-3g ntfsprogs >/dev/null 2>&1 && command -v mkfs.ntfs mount.ntfs-3g >/dev/null 2>&1

RepoFlathub.Description: The main Flatpak app store. Every Flatpak entry in TuxThrottle installs from it (emulators, Sober, Chiaki-ng, …).

RepoFlathubBeta.Description: Pre-release builds from Flathub: newer emulator / launcher builds before they reach stable. Adding the remote changes nothing on its own; pick the beta branch per app in Discover or with flatpak install flathub-beta <id>.

RepoTerra.Description: Nobara ships this enabled. It's where LACT, Vesktop, Faugus Launcher, ProtonPlus, RPCS3, OpenTabletDriver, xpadneo, CoolerControl and Heroic come from as native RPMs. This entry re-enables it if it was switched off, or installs terra-release if the repo file is missing.
install: if [ -f /etc/yum.repos.d/terra.repo ]; then dnf config-manager setopt terra.enabled=1; else dnf install -y --nogpgcheck --repofrompath 'terra,https://repos.fyralabs.com/terra$releasever' terra-release terra-gpg-keys; fi

RepoNobaraUpdates.Description: Nobara's own repos carry Lutris, umu-launcher, wine-staging, winetricks, gamescope-session, xone, GOverlay and MangoJuice (RPM Fusion content is merged in). This re-enables nobara and nobara-updates if either was switched off.
RepoNobaraUpdates.check: dnf repolist --enabled 2>/dev/null | grep -q '^nobara-updates ' && dnf repolist --enabled 2>/dev/null | grep -q '^nobara '

FaugusLauncher.Description: Simple umu-launcher/Proton front-end for non-Steam Windows games (Battle.net, EA app, Ubisoft Connect, standalone .exe).

UmuLauncher.Description: Runs any Windows game in the Steam Runtime + Proton outside Steam (what Lutris, Heroic and Faugus use under the hood). Includes the protonfixes database.

WineStaging.Description: System Wine for installers and tools that don't need Proton, plus winetricks for DLLs/fonts.

SteamTinkerLaunch.Description: Per-game Steam launch wrapper: ReShade, vkBasalt, mod managers (Vortex/MO2), custom commands and gamescope settings via a GUI instead of launch-option strings.

MangoJuice.Description: Modern GTK MangoHud configurator (an alternative to GOverlay).

SGDBoop.Description: One-click SteamGridDB artwork for non-Steam shortcuts in your Steam library.

Sober.Description: Runs the Android build of Roblox natively on Linux (Roblox's Windows client blocks Wine/Proton).

RetroArch.Description: Multi-system emulator frontend (libretro cores): NES through PS1/N64 and arcade.

Ryubing.Description: Nintendo Switch emulator, the maintained Ryujinx fork.

OpenTabletDriver.Description: User-mode drawing-tablet driver with low-latency absolute mapping; the standard for osu! tablet players. Enable the user service afterwards: systemctl --user enable --now opentabletdriver.

Xpadneo.Description: Kernel driver for Xbox One/Series controllers over Bluetooth: rumble, correct button mapping, battery level. DKMS/akmod build, so reboot after install.

Xone.Description: Kernel driver for the Microsoft Xbox Wireless USB adapter and wired Xbox controllers. akmod build, so reboot after install.

SteamDevices.Description: udev rules so Steam Controller, Steam Deck, DualShock/DualSense and Valve Index hardware work without root.

InputRemapper.Description: Remap keys, mouse buttons and gamepad buttons per device, including macros. Enable the service afterwards: systemctl enable --now input-remapper.

Piper.Description: Configure gaming mice (DPI steps, polling rate, button mapping, LEDs) through libratbag. Logitech, SteelSeries, Roccat and others.

Solaar.Description: Logitech Unifying / Lightspeed / Bolt receiver manager: pairing, battery, DPI, onboard profiles.

AntiMicroX.Description: Map gamepad buttons to keyboard/mouse input for games without controller support.

LACT.Description: Linux GPU Control Application: clocks, power limit, fan curves and undervolt for AMD and NVIDIA. Enables its daemon (lactd) after install.

CoolerControl.Description: Fan and pump curves from any temperature sensor, with a GUI (liquidctl + hwmon devices).

Vesktop.Description: Discord client with working Wayland screen-share and audio capture, plus Vencord plugins.
